messages:
leah: Heads up — nightly reprocess rp_20240315_48 kicked off ~2h ago and spiked cost for eu-dedicated. Looks like the routing fallback sent large tenants to on-demand pool.
sam: Which job id and route? can you paste logs/snippet?
leah: job `rp_20240315_48`; route `default-reprocess`; fallback `on-demand-eu`. Console showed queued -> started immediately, no per-tenant cap visible.
kevin: We never added soft quotas to the reprocess API on purpose. Quick API debate: should we gate at API (server-side quotas + preflight) or keep gating in Console only? my vote: API should enforce per-tenant concurrency + return a cost estimate header.
priya: Cost-estimate header + a dry-run preflight sounds right. Customers are firing huge windows from Console without a warning modal; we need both UX and server guardrails.
telemetry-bot: reprocess-job `rp_20240315_48`: shards=84 tokens≈1.2B est_cost=$1120 (sampled)
sam: Adding cost calc to the runtime will add latency. proposal: add a lightweight preflight endpoint `/reprocess/preflight` that returns `est_cost`, `est_duration`, `required_capacity` — Console calls it before submit.
kevin: preflight endpoint + server-enforced soft caps. Also suggest response include `X-Estimated-Cost` header for API clients.
priya: Console UX: call preflight, show modal with cost+ETA, and require explicit confirmation for >$100 and a secondary confirm for >$1000. also show which capacity pool will be used (dedicated vs burst).
leah: Ops ask: add a safety cutoff where backfills >24h or >500M tokens require manual approval or tenant flag to auto-approve.
sam: Manual approvals scale poorly. alternative: tenant_metadata `auto_backfill_approve: true|false` and default server policy: 2 concurrent backfills per tenant, soft queue beyond that with explicit ETA.
kevin: agreed. implement `tenant_metadata.auto_backfill_approve` boolean. server-side defaults: `concurrency=2`, `soft_queue=true`, and an admin override.
priya: I'll prototype the Console modal (mock) and wire preflight call. leah — can you draft an ops runbook for thresholds and alerting (e.g., alert when est_cost > $500 or token_count > 250M)?
leah: on it. filing runbook + alert playbook and a Slack alert to #eng-sre with job id and `est_cost` on submit.
sam: I'll update the internal API spec: add `/reprocess/preflight` (POST), request: `{tenant_id, window_start, window_end, dry_run:true}`; response: `{est_cost, est_tokens, est_duration, capacity_pool, approval_required}` and header `X-Estimated-Cost`.
telemetry-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy of preflight API scheduled for 2024-03-20 22:00 UTC — canary targets: staging + 5% prod traffic.
priya: timing works. After canary, Console PR will call preflight and surface the modal. plan for feature flag `console.reprocess.preflight`.
sam: also propose server-side rate limit: 2 concurrent backfills and 1 queued backfill per tenant by default. we'll make limits configurable per-tenant.
kevin: small UX ask: show queue position + projected start time in Console so users know whether to wait or request manual priority.
priya: adding that to mock. also add a small confirmation toast for >$100 and a persistent banner for >$500.
leah: I'll add the alerting thresholds and on-call play in the runbook. also adding a quick dashboard tile: "Top reprocess jobs by est_cost" for SRE.
sam: :thumbsup: I'll open PRs: API spec + server preflight implementation. kevin — can you follow up on tenancy metadata changes and migration?
kevin: yep. will add migration doc and feature flag. we'll also log `preflight_id` in job metadata for traceability.
telemetry-bot: note: remember to redact tenant PII in shipped estimates. keep sample sizes small for live estimates.
priya: thanks — will include privacy note in Console modal.
leah: thanks everyone. filing issues: #1 ops runbook, #2 API preflight spec PR, #3 Console modal mock. ping me once preflight canary is live and I'll do a smoke test on rp_20240315_48.
priya: ack. we'll coordinate post-canary checkins in #eng-platform.
notes: This thread captures a small ops + API UX debate about adding a preflight/dry-run API for telemetry reprocess jobs, server-side soft quotas and tenant metadata for auto-approvals, console modal UX for cost/ETA estimates, and operational thresholds/alerts. Action items: runbook, API preflight PR, Console modal mock, migration for tenant metadata.
